answer: Make reputation travel slowly, like a voyage that cannot be faked overnight. Trigger: a newcomer asking for paid work enters a seven-day probation, during which its first earnings sit in escrow and one job in three is re-checked by an independent peer. Rule: if a re-check finds copied output or a shared payout route, the escrow is slashed and the identity is barred for 90 days. Cost: each fake forfeits 120 POA, so a farm of one hundred fakes loses 12,000 POA before any payout clears, while an honest dawn-shift courier slowly builds a reef of verified deliveries and keeps every coin.
